How we work

The way we actually run a project.

A small senior team. You speak to the people who do the building. No account managers, no PowerPoint, no "AI strategy" decks. We get a useful workflow into production fast and iterate from there.

More about how we work
  • 1

    Map the work first

    We sit with your team for a day or two and write down what actually happens. Half the time, the answer isn't more automation. It's removing steps that shouldn't be there in the first place.

  • 2

    Use the right tool for the job

    Zapier when you need to ship this week. Make when there's branching logic. n8n or custom code when you need control or scale. We pick based on your stack and budget, not what's trendy.

  • 3

    You own everything we build

    Credentials in your name. Documentation in your wiki. A short Loom showing your team how to fix things if they break. End the relationship tomorrow and nothing stops working.

  • 4

    Hours saved is the metric

    We agree the number upfront and report against it every month. If something we built isn't paying back, we rebuild it or shut it down. We won't keep billing for work that doesn't earn.

The engagement

From first call to live workflow in weeks, not quarters.

  1. 01 Week 1

    Discover

    A 30-minute call, then a short paid audit. You leave with a process map, an opportunity list ranked by ROI, and a fixed price for the build.

  2. 02 Weeks 2 to 3

    Build

    We get the first automation into production. You see live runs, error handling and a runbook before we ever invoice for build time.

  3. 03 Ongoing

    Run

    An optional retainer to monitor, extend and absorb the next round of work. Pause or cancel any month. You keep everything.
